_comment: Single source of truth for the shared deck.gl + Mosaic runtime versions across the dbverse visualization stack (dbVisuals2 frontend, the bundled viewer, rDeckgl, rMosaic). Enforced by frontend/sqlrooms-ai/scripts/check-viz-versions.mjs (npm run test:versions). See COMPATIBILITY.md.
policy: The dbVisuals2 frontend is the contract anchor: its deck.gl and Mosaic versions are pinned transitively by the @sqlrooms release it depends on, so they cannot move freely. The R export targets (rDeckgl, rMosaic) and the combined widget (mosaic.gl) must satisfy these ranges so that specs authored through the dbVisuals2 LLM bridge render identically in the R htmlwidgets. When a @sqlrooms upgrade moves the frontend out of `contract`, update `contract` here and bump the R bundles in the same change.

mosaic.gl._comment: The linked Mosaic + deck.gl viewer, vendored into the R package. Was a separate mosaic.gl checkout; now in-repo so this check is self-contained.

rDeckgl._comment: rDeckgl is on CRAN. This path points at an optional local development checkout; absent on a fresh clone, which the check reports as skipped.

rMosaic._comment: rMosaic is on CRAN. This path points at an optional local development checkout; absent on a fresh clone, which the check reports as skipped.

knownDeviations.reason: rDeckgl's committed bundle predates the 9.3 anchor. Action: migrate rDeckgl to a viewer-src/package.json + vite build (as mosaic.gl already does), pin deck.gl to the contract range, and rebuild the bundle.

mosaic.gl is ahead of the SQLRooms-pinned 0.21 anchor. Acceptable for the standalone widget (pristine upstream Mosaic), but align downward when SQLRooms upgrades Mosaic so exported specs stay byte-compatible.
